name: f1muse-api
description: F1 analytics backend - deterministic query validation and execution

scripts.test:unit:db:docker: npm run db:test:up && npm run test:unit:db; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.test:integration:db: npm run db:test:up && REQUIRE_TEST_DATABASE=true DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test vitest run tests/integration/matchup-matrix.test.ts tests/integration/multi-driver-comparison.test.ts tests/contract tests/cache; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.test:api:inprocess: npm run db:test:up && REQUIRE_TEST_DATABASE=true DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test vitest run tests/api; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.test:f1ql: npm run db:test:up && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/f1ql; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.golden:snapshot:f1ql-corpus-results: npm run db:test:up && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test tsx scripts/snapshot-f1ql-golden-corpus-results.ts; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.test:golden:db: npm run db:test:up && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test npm run test:golden; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.test:schema:db: npm run db:test:up && REQUIRE_TEST_DATABASE=true DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test DATABASE_URL_TEST=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/f1muse_test vitest run tests/schema; status=$?; npm run db:test:down; exit $status
scripts.validate:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.validate:quick: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:nl
scripts.validate:full: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:nl && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:test:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d && sh scripts/wait-for-test-db.sh
scripts.etl:qualifying:all: npm run etl:qualifying:2022 && npm run etl:qualifying:2023 && npm run etl:qualifying:2024 && npm run etl:qualifying:2025 && npm run etl:qualifying:2026
scripts.sync:all: npm run etl:laps:all && npm run etl:qualifying:2026 && npm run ingest:race-results && npm run sync:f1db -- --etl-only
